verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Greptile supports a generic API key (GREPTILE_API_KEY) for CI and self-hosted use, plus OAuth for connecting MCP clients. Nothing documents scoping, permission limits, or least-privilege credentials issued for an agent. A plain API key or OAuth login is an adjacent authentication mechanism, not the scoped-credential capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
